events.verdict: Allen (CLE) establishes himself in Vassell's (SAS) path and does not deliver illegal contact as he sets the pick.

Okoro (CLE) establishes himself in Johnson's (SAS) path and does not deliver illegal contact as the screen is set, and the two momentarily engage and disengage with one another following the initial contact. Okoro is still established in a screening position when he absorbs further contact with Jones (SAS) near the block.
Vassell (SAS) jumps forward slightly prior to marginal body contact occurring with Allen's (CLE) back as Allen elevates for the rebound.
Wembanyama (SAS) and Allen (CLE) engage and disengage with one another after the release of the shot attempt.
Mitchell (CLE) initiates contact across Wembanyama's (SAS) left arm after Wembanyama's gather.
Sochan (SAS) and LeVert (CLE) engage and disengage with one another during the inbound.
Vassell's (SAS) left forearm comes forward prior to marginal contact occurring with Strus' (CLE) front as Strus mishandles the ball during the drive.
Sochan (SAS) brings his hands down toward the ball prior to marginal contact occurring with Strus' (CLE) left arm as Strus passes.
Wembanyama (SAS) cleanly blocks the shot attempt prior to the ball reaching its apex.
Jones (SAS) makes clean fingertip contact with the ball prior to any marginal contact occurring with LeVert's (CLE) right side after LeVert receives the inbound.
Sochan (SAS) legally contests Allen's (CLE) layup attempt.
Allen (CLE) makes clean contact with the ball and momentarily dislodges it away from Wembanyama (SAS) after Wembanyama secures the rebound.
Allen (CLE) initiates contact with Wembanyama's (SAS) side and left leg in transition. The transition take foul rule does not apply to the last two minutes of either the fourth quarter or overtime.
Johnson (SAS) brings his left arm forward prior to marginal contact occurring with Mitchell's (CLE) right side as Mitchell receives the inbound.

Replay review of the foul called on Jones (SAS) pursuant to a coach's challenge was deemed successful. Jones makes clean contact with the ball and dislodges it away from Mitchell (CLE) prior to any incidental contact occurring. There was not imminent possession at the time of the whistle and a jump ball at center circle was assessed.
Allen (CLE) briefly has his arms around Wembanyama's (SAS) upper half before correcting.
Allen (CLE) is moving alongside Wembanyama's (SAS) path and absorbs the marginal body contact that occurs as Wembanyama cuts back toward him after the gather.
Johnson (SAS) moves forward slightly prior to marginal body contact occurring with Mitchell's (CLE) back after Mitchell receives the inbound.
Johnson (SAS) briefly places his arms around Allen's (CLE) midsection and then quickly releases as the pick is set.
Wembanyama (SAS) makes clean contact with the ball and momentarily dislodges it away from Mitchell (CLE) during the drive.

Wembanyama (SAS) and Allen (CLE) engage and disengage with one another after the release of the shot attempt, and marginal contact occurs prior to Wembanyama back-tapping the rebound toward the corner.
LeVert (CLE) grasps and then quickly releases Wembanyama's (SAS) jersey as the pass into the lane is made.

events.category: Turnover: Out of Bounds - Bad Pass Turn
events.verdict: Johnson (SAS) touches the ball last before it goes out of bounds.
Johnson (SAS) moves forward into Merrill (CLE) and initiates body contact that affects Merrill's SQBR along the sideline.
Vassell (SAS) slightly extends forward as he defends the inbound, and marginal contact occurs with Merrill's (CLE) side and slightly extended right arm when he gains control of the ball.
Sochan (SAS) turns slightly prior to marginal body contact occurring with LeVert (CLE) during LeVert's upward shooting motion. Wembanyama (SAS) then cleanly blocks LeVert's layup attempt.
Jones (SAS) avoids stepping on the sideline prior to saving the ball back into play.
Allen (CLE) legally contests Sochan's (SAS) jump shot attempt.
